text:
maria: Heads up — p99 jumped ~2.1x in prod-dc2 after the kernel swap at 08:12, p95 looks fine. digging in.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: runtime-kernel-v3 -> prod-dc2 by @sam at 08:11 :white_check_mark:

sam: I pushed kernel-v3 because bench improved p95 on short sequences. did we leave microbatch=auto?

leo: Profiling shows KV miss rate up ~18% and extra context-switch stalls on the new kernel path. tail samples point to slow attention kernel for >512 tokens.

maria: p95 stable but p99 tail — sounds like a mix of cold-KV + a slow fast-path for long sequences.

pradeep: product note — Nimbus pilot expects p99<=450ms ideally. Sales is asking what we can commit with the kernel change.

nicole: Nimbus told us they need predictable tail. they'd accept p95<=250ms and p99<=600ms for the pilot window if we document limitations.

sam: Quick bench: microbatch=8 cuts p99 down ~30% but throughput drops ~15% at peak qps. microbatch=4 is middle ground.

leo: Suggestion: revert kernel-v3 in dc2, then run an A/B where 10% traffic uses v3 with microbatch=4 + KV prewarm for Nimbus. that isolates tail risk.

maria: Also propose a fallback rule: for sequences >512 tokens, route to quantized-kernel-v2 to avoid the slow attention path in v3.

sam: We can implement customer-based routing: simple canary on header x-customer-id==nimbus. config snippet:
```yaml
route_rules:
  - match: header(x-customer-id)=="nimbus"
    percent: 10
    kernel: runtime-kernel-v3
  - match: seq_len>512
    kernel: runtime-kernel-v2-quant
```

nicole: Nimbus will accept a 10% canary if we provide daily perf dashboards and quick rollback plan. they want visibility into p95/p99 by workspace.

pradeep: For SLO negotiation: propose internal default p95=200ms / p99=500ms for gold tier. For Nimbus pilot, accept p99<=600ms for 2 weeks with daily monitoring. after that we re-evaluate commitments.

leo: Action items: 1) rollback kernel-v3 in prod-dc2 (maria), 2) add canary routing + KV prewarm for Nimbus (sam), 3) add sequence-length fallback to quant-kernel (sam+leo), 4) dashboard for Nimbus p95/p99 and tail traces (pradeep+nicole), 5) capture flamegraphs and store tail-sample traces (leo).

maria: I'll start rollback now, ETA ~30m. will collect traces and link them to the thread.

deploy-bot: rollback started: runtime-kernel-v2 -> prod-dc2 by @maria at 08:46 :arrow_down:

sam: I'll land the canary rule + KV prewarm script in the next 2 hours and ping here when ready.

nicole: :thumbsup: I'll tell Nimbus and set expectations for daily updates.

leo: Please remember to tag traces with "customer:nimbus" so we can slice tail behavior. also capture top-10 slow queries per minute.

maria: noted. I'll add tags and upload a handful of tail traces to the S3 perf bucket. link will follow.

sam: one more note — microbatch tuning per-customer might be necessary; we should avoid a global microbatch knob when customers have different latency/throughput mixes.

pradeep: Agreed. we'll document customer-specific microbatch profiles in the SLO matrix and include escalation steps.

maria: Thanks everyone. ping me if Nimbus sees anything weird during the rollback.

leo: I'll schedule a short postmortem and a perf run to reproduce with a controlled KV miss mix.

maria: uploading initial traces now.
